exact_target: Construct the actual bounded inverse-generator cutoffs B_epsilon=(h+epsilon)^(-1) for epsilon>0 as epsilon^(-1) theta_(log epsilon)(R), with the SAME R=(1+h)^(-1). Prove core membership, positivity, bound by epsilon^(-1), graph equation h(B_epsilon x)=x-epsilon B_epsilon x, and dual transport theta_s B_epsilon=exp(s) B_(epsilon exp(s)). Consumer: the existing inverse-generator trace formula in LACUNAS_A1 item4. Reuse dual action and graph scaling; no new CFC, generator, base L2 or substitute trace. No assertion of additivity or traciality of a supremum before its monotonicity is established.

providers.name: regularSpectralResolvent
providers.statement:
def regularSpectralResolvent (P : SiteProfile) :
    RegularHilbert (TowerHilbert P) →L[ℂ] RegularHilbert (TowerHilbert P)

providers.name: regularSpectralResolvent_mem
providers.statement:
theorem regularSpectralResolvent_mem (P : SiteProfile) :
    regularSpectralResolvent P ∈ regularCoreAlgebra P

providers.name: regularPositiveGenerator_dual_graph
providers.statement:
theorem regularPositiveGenerator_dual_graph (P : SiteProfile) (s : ℝ)
    (x y : RegularHilbert (TowerHilbert P))
    (hxy : (x,y) ∈ (regularPositiveGenerator P).graph) :
    (characterMultiplier s x,(Real.exp s : ℂ) • characterMultiplier s y) ∈
      (regularPositiveGenerator P).graph

providers.name: dualAmbient_add
providers.statement:
theorem dualAmbient_add (s t : ℝ) :
    dualAmbient (H := H) (s+t) = (dualAmbient (H := H) s).trans (dualAmbient (H := H) t)

providers.name: regularDualAction
providers.statement:
def regularDualAction (P : SiteProfile) (s : ℝ) :
    (regularCoreAlgebra P).toStarSubalgebra ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] (regularCoreAlgebra P).toStarSubalgebra

providers.name: resolvent_graph_resolvent_equation
providers.statement:
theorem resolvent_graph_resolvent_equation (R : H →L[ℂ] H) (hi : Function.Injective R)
    (u : H) : ∃ x : (resolventGraphOperator R hi).domain,
      (x : H) = R u ∧ (x : H) + resolventGraphOperator R hi x = u

providers.name: characterMultiplier_inverse
providers.statement:
theorem characterMultiplier_inverse (s : ℝ) (f : RegularHilbert H) :
    characterMultiplier s (characterMultiplier (-s) f) = f
